PLAN: Finish by adopting R321's validated intermediate TT boil-up of 0.75, which improves slightly on the prior 0.8 optimum while remaining above the C3 blend purity cliff.
Best available reward is 2.953. TT boil-up reductions from 1.2 through 0.8 improved recovery and cost; 0.7 failed the 95% C3-blend specification and caused a large loss. R321 demonstrates that 0.75 remains sellable, raises C3 revenue to $70.6M/yr, and reduces TT cost to $9.7M/yr. All other backbone settings remain optimal: feed 50/3/2/dp0.2; B 120/9.5/3.6/dp0.1; T 40/3/2.5/dp0.1; BB 100/6/7.1/dp0.35; TT 30/5/0.75/dp0.1. Heavy polishing and side draws are uneconomic.
